description: Write. Sends one past webhook delivery again, right away, to the webhook's current URL, with the same X-Strait-Delivery id (receivers that de-duplicate on it are safe); its retry schedule starts over. For failed deliveries. This re-sends a real event into the receiving system, so it needs confirm: true; without it nothing is sent. Refused (409) when already delivered or being sent right now. A paused webhook must be turned back on first (Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks), otherwise the redelivery fails at once.

confirm.description: true to send it; omit or false to preview

name: redeliver_webhook_delivery
title: Redeliver a webhook delivery
